stories.title: PinkPantheress takes a Zara Larsson cutout to the VMAs
stories.summary: At the VMAs, PinkPantheress posed with her award for the "Stateside" video and a cardboard cutout of her collaborator Zara Larsson. The photo got 201K likes. BTS won Best Group, Best K-Pop and Song of the Year for "SWIM", and their thank-you post got 210K.
